Now I understand the codebase. Let me also look at the test file to see what tests already exist and understand what behavior is expected.

Let me first summarize the requirements:
- [R6] The Parser must correctly identify and convert hexadecimal, binary, and octal integers, including optional base arguments and automatic base detection.
- [R7] The convert_first function and related internal conversion mechanisms must be implemented using functors instead of inner functions or lambdas to ensure they are picklable.
- [R8] The findall function must respect the case_sensitive parameter when searching for patterns.
- [R9] Left- and center-aligned search operations must consume input up to the next space character.
- [R10] Result instances must support slice access to retrieve subsets of the parsed values.
